rubric_items.reason: All nine design components have at least one threat. The components that handle PII (patientsRouter, PatientService and PatientRepo) each have several threats.

Most threats are specific to this change: medical history in the list mapping, wildcard select, inference from the doctor, and the zone fallback. T-7 (reusing AppointmentRepo write paths by mistake) is speculative.
Each mitigation either cites an existing control (C4, C6, C16, C17, C18) or states a clearly new, testable control. The earlier uncited T-5 and T-10 bases are now fixed.
Assumptions T-4, T-8 and T-11 each give a basis. The unknowns U-1 to U-3 each map to a question (Q-01 to Q-03), and Q-03 links to design Q-05. Q-01 no longer assumes staff-only access.
Clear and ordered by risk with the highest first. The front matter and the body still repeat each other heavily.

findings.text: T-3 proposes a new test that list items carry no medical history, but an existing test, PAT-8, already covers this. T-3 does not cite PAT-8 as an existing control.

cites.quote: add a test that GET /api/patients items contain no medical history fields
PAT-8: lists and appointment views never carry medical history

findings.suggested_fix: Cite PAT-8 (api/test/patients.test.ts) as an existing control in T-3 and say to extend it to cover next_appointment instead of adding a separate test.

findings.text: C18 says the addition carries only id, start and doctor_name, but it cites only design.md#L177, which lists doctor_name alone. The full contract that supports 'only' is at L173-L178.

the client type is `{ id, starts_at, doctor_name } | null`
